comment: Things that live in your bag, who sells them, and what workbenches make. Read by src/content/items.ts. Prices are copper (100c = 1s, 100s = 1g). Trade and material packs are not items: they ride on your back or in a vehicle (shared/trade.json). `categories`: what each kind of item is called (`name` in a tooltip, `group` as a heading) and what using one is called in the bag (`verb`); what using it does is the rules' (src/sim/life/interact.ts useItem), so a new category is new code. A placeable says where it is placed (`placeOn`: ground, a farm plot's scarecrow; housePlot, a house blueprint; slipway, a ship design) and what using it tells you (`hint`).
